facts.fact: Silver 曾要求 Adam 再次跨界前先征得许可。
facts.anchor: Silver had asked that he request permission before crossing the boundary again.

facts.fact: Jack 的新线索是 Archive Infinite——一个老派、模拟式的档案：凡是写下来的精灵宗教资料，那里都会有。
facts.anchor: They’re old school. Analog. If there’s anything written down about the elven religion, they’d have it.

facts.fact: 给 Archive Infinite 投信的邮箱不但关乎地点更关乎时间——例如把信在 1937 年 3 月的第一个周二放进箱子。
facts.anchor: Like, put the letter in the box on the first Tuesday of March in 1937.

facts.fact: 那位学者说最好问她「曾经是谁、过去是什么」——她的回答是：她曾是一名图书管理员。
facts.anchor: “It would be better to ask who I was, or what I used to be.” She turned to Jack. “I was a librarian.”

facts.fact: 学者从包里掏出一只黄铜圆筒交给他们，说「这能把你们送到那里」（去 Archive）。
facts.anchor: She dug around in her bag until she produced a brass cylinder. “This will get you there.”

facts.fact: Adam 决定拿出自家（Binder 家族）的 grimoire——它古老、独一无二，他虽不舍但已扫描并做了备份。
facts.anchor: “My family’s grimoire. I don’t like giving it up but I’ve scanned and backed it up. It’s ancient but also one of a kind.”

facts.fact: Adam 解释为何非要这些信息：six souls missing——六个灵魂失踪，六个人被困在身体之外的某处，他相信此事与之相关。
facts.anchor: “There are six souls missing, six people trapped somewhere outside their bodies. I don’t know how, but this is connected.”

facts.fact: 结尾 Adam 拉出床下的塑料盒时立刻觉得太轻——Binder 家族的 grimoire 被人拿走了。
facts.anchor: he went to pull the plastic case from beneath the bed. He instantly felt that it was too light.
